subject: Error in uniroot & Error in naivecap2

messages.author: 90e12dcb96ba1246
messages.subject: Error in uniroot & Error in naivecap2
parts:
Hi All,

When I try to estimate density using the secr.fit function, I get the following error message:

> taragree10 <- read.capthist ("char10.csv", "traptar10.csv", detector ="proximity",fmt = c("trapID"), noccasions =10, covnames =c("V5", "V6"), trapcovnames = NULL, cutval = NULL, verify = TRUE, noncapt = "NONE", binary.usage="TRUE")
No errors found :-)

> nullmodeltar10<-secr.fit(taragree10, model = list(D~1, g0~1, sigma~1), mask=HRmask, verify = TRUE)
Checking data
Preparing detection design matrices
Preparing density design matrix
Finding initial parameter values...
Error in uniroot(naiveRPSVcall, lower = obsRPSV/10, upper = obsRPSV *  :
  f() values at end points not of opposite sign
Error in naivecap2(0.001, sigma = tempsigma, cap = cpa) :
  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 3)

Does someone know what I am doing wrong?

Thank you!

Marie-Lyne

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in uniroot & Error in naivecap2
parts:
Hello Marie-Lyne
The error you report is coming from the initial 'autoini' step, when secr.fit finds starting values for the likelihood maximization. I'm guessing your data are limited in some way (no recaptures at different sites?), or the mask is inappropriate; I admit the message is not informative. If you have checked the data and the mask (plotting is always helpful) the next step is to override the automatic starting values by specifying them yourself (e.g., start = list(D=2, g0=0.1, sigma=30) where D is in animals/ha and sigma is in metres).
Murray

P.S. The idea of covnames is to provide informative labels of your choice - perhaps you can do better than V5?
